title: Isaiah 45: I Form the Light and Create Darkness
body:
Read the chapter → [Isaiah 45](/bible/isaiah/45)

**[Isaiah 45:1-3](/bible/isaiah/45#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/isaiah/45#v1)</sup> Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/isaiah/45#v2)</sup> I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/isaiah/45#v3)</sup> And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.

- Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him and loose the loins of kings, to open the two-leaved gates that shall not be shut.
- I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight, break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut asunder the bars of iron. I will give thee the treasures of darkness and the hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I the Lord which called thee by thy name am the God of Israel.

**[Isaiah 45:4-7](/bible/isaiah/45#v4)**

> <sup>[4](/bible/isaiah/45#v4)</sup> For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/isaiah/45#v5)</sup> I am the Lord, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/isaiah/45#v6)</sup> That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the Lord, and there is none else.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/isaiah/45#v7)</sup> I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things.

- For Jacob my servant's sake and Israel mine elect, I have called thee by thy name and surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me. I am the Lord and there is none else, that they may know from the rising of the sun and from the west that there is none beside me.
- I form the light and create darkness, I make peace and create evil; I the Lord do all these things. The Most High creates good and evil, makes alive and kills; this is one of the basic precepts to hold onto.

**[Isaiah 45:8-10](/bible/isaiah/45#v8)**

> <sup>[8](/bible/isaiah/45#v8)</sup> Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the Lord have created it.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/isaiah/45#v9)</sup> Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/isaiah/45#v10)</sup> Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?

- Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness; let the earth open and bring forth salvation. Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker; shall the clay say to him that fashioned it, what makest thou, or hath he no hands?
- We cannot kick against the pricks or grieve the holy spirit; let the Lord do what he needs to do while using us, so we can go home and get out of here.

**[Isaiah 45:11-13](/bible/isaiah/45#v11)**

> <sup>[11](/bible/isaiah/45#v11)</sup> Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/isaiah/45#v12)</sup> I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/isaiah/45#v13)</sup> I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts.

- Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker: ask me of things to come concerning my sons and the work of my hands. I have made the earth and created man upon it, my hands have stretched out the heavens and commanded all their host.
- I have raised him up in righteousness and will direct all his ways; he shall build my city and let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts.

**[Isaiah 45:14-17](/bible/isaiah/45#v14)**

> <sup>[14](/bible/isaiah/45#v14)</sup> Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/isaiah/45#v15)</sup> Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/isaiah/45#v16)</sup> They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/isaiah/45#v17)</sup> But Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

- Thus saith the Lord, the labour of Egypt and the merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee in chains, and fall down and make supplication, saying surely God is in thee and there is none else. This is prophecy that the Africans, the men of stature, come over in chains, because they sold us into slavery to the so-called white man, the Grecians.
- Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour. They that are makers of idols shall be ashamed and confounded and go into confusion together, but Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation, not ashamed nor confounded, world without end.
- The word "world" means a group of people with common goals or interests, like the sports world or basketball world, so "world without end" and God so loved the world are not speaking of everybody but of Israel.
  - **[Joel 3:4-6](/bible/joel/3#v4)**
    > <sup>[4](/bible/joel/3#v4)</sup> Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
    >
    > <sup>[5](/bible/joel/3#v5)</sup> Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
    >
    > <sup>[6](/bible/joel/3#v6)</sup> The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.

    Tyre, Zidon, and the coasts of Palestine, the modern-day Arabs of Ishmael, sold the children of Judah and Jerusalem to the Grecians, the white people united under Alexander; God returns their recompense on their own head.

**[Isaiah 45:18-25](/bible/isaiah/45#v18)**

> <sup>[18](/bible/isaiah/45#v18)</sup> For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord; and there is none else.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/isaiah/45#v19)</sup> I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the Lord speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/isaiah/45#v20)</sup> Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/isaiah/45#v21)</sup> Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the Lord? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/isaiah/45#v22)</sup> Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/isaiah/45#v23)</sup> I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/isaiah/45#v24)</sup> Surely, shall one say, in the Lord have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
>
> <sup>[25](/bible/isaiah/45#v25)</sup> In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

- For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens, that formed the earth and made it, who established it and created it not in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord and there is none else. He made us the ones to rule over the earth, and it will go back to being like that.
- I have not spoken in secret in a dark place; I said not unto the seed of Jacob, seek me in vain. I the Lord speak righteousness and declare things that are right. As Paul said, we are not fighting like one that beateth the air; there is a reason.
- Assemble yourselves, ye that are escaped of the nations, who have no knowledge, that set up the wood of their graven image and pray unto a god that cannot save. Come out from among them and be separate, touch not the unclean thing, and I will receive you.
- There is no God else beside me, a just God and a Saviour; look unto me and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth, for God scattered us to the ends of the earth. I have sworn by myself that unto me every knee shall bow and every tongue shall swear; in the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified and shall glory.
  - **[Exodus 20:7](/bible/exodus/20#v7)**
    > <sup>[7](/bible/exodus/20#v7)</sup> Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

    Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain, for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
  - **[Deuteronomy 28:64](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v64)**
    > <sup>[64](/bible/deuteronomy/28#v64)</sup> And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.

    The Lord shall scatter thee among all people, and there thou shalt serve other gods of wood and stone; two of the false religions we were cursed into serving are Christianity and Islam, gods our fathers never knew.
